raw_text: He was tired. The anxiety, insomnia, and the panic attacks that were all but behind him had taken their toll. His son not 50 feet away from him, staring at his phone and mumbling to himself. His wife in a home office not more than 100 ft from him arranging the release of several employees at her company. The time away from his own job combined with the beginning of what would be 8 wees of therapy increasing the weight of feeling useless in every way. His family ambivalent, not just because they were engaged now, but all the time. It was then that he made a decision that would change everything.
